entities.summary: Anton Aleksandrovich Igumnov, professionally known as Tony Igy, is a Russian electronic dance music disc jockey and producer. He is best known for his hit "Astronomia", which was originally released in 2010. A 2014 Vicetone remix of "Astronomia" became a global phenomenon in April 2020 as part of the Coffin dance meme.
